questions.question: What kind of king was Manasseh of Judah?
options: A foreign ruler imposed by Assyria
Good and faithful, trusting the LORD
Weak but harmless, doing little at all
Very wicked, leading Judah into idolatry
questions.answer: Very wicked, leading Judah into idolatry

questions.question: What did Manasseh do that was especially evil?
options: Rebuilt the whole temple and all its furnishings
Shed much innocent blood and practiced sorcery
Raised very heavy taxes on all of the people
Waged constant war on the surrounding nations
questions.answer: Shed much innocent blood and practiced sorcery

questions.question: Manasseh reigned longer than any other king of Judah (fifty-five years).
King _____ led Judah into terrible idolatry and shed much innocent blood.
Manasseh even built _____ for false gods in the temple of the LORD.
